summary: Willamette NF L-5 cab; built 1933 or 1934 (sources disagree), staffed in the 1930s, abandoned in the 1940s, gone by 1962; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-5 cab; 10x10 per the Oregon list (no unit given)
facts.status_note: The Oregon list marks it removed. The register and firelookout.com say gone by 1962; the Oregon list says abandoned in the 1940s.

staffing.status: last staffing record in the sources: 1938, as lookout fireman

events.note: Eugene Guard item, August 24, 1932, says new lookout houses will be built, Hemlock mountain among them. A plan, not confirmation of construction.
L-5 cab per the register and firelookout.com.
Panorama photo taken by James Rittenhouse, dated September 1, 1933, on the Oregon list.
Oregon list says a 10x10 L-5 lookout house was built in 1934. Conflicts with the 1933 date.
Clayton Kelsay sent to the emergency station on Hemlock mountain to serve as lookout fireman (Eugene Register-Guard, September 23, 1934).
Gordon Stanely burned on the arms at his Hemlock Butte station; Horace Lundberg took his place for several days (Eugene Guard, August 18, 1938).
Oregon list says the lookout was abandoned in the 1940s.
Register and firelookout.com say gone by 1962. No exact removal date is given.
Registered May 8, 2011, on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register.

evidence.supports: built 1933 as an L-5 cab, gone by 1962
evidence.quote: Built in 1933, this L-5 cab was gone by 1962.
1934: A 10x10 L-5 lookout house was built.

evidence.supports: August 1932 item on planned houses including Hemlock mountain
evidence.quote: New lookout houses will be built at He-He mountain, Sardine butte, Holland Meadows, Eagle's Rest, Pack Saddle mountain and Hemlock mountain.
Panorama photo taken by James Rittenhouse.

evidence.supports: September 1934 emergency station and lookout fireman
evidence.quote: Clayton Kelsay has gone to the emergency station on Hemlock mountain to serve as lookout fireman until it rains.

evidence.supports: 1938 burns to arms and medical treatment
evidence.quote: Gordon Stanely who was burned on the arms while at his station at Hemlock Butte came down for medical treatment.

evidence.supports: Horace Lundberg took his place for several days
evidence.quote: His place was taken for several days by Horace Lundberg.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1933 for the L-5 cab. The Oregon list gives 1934 for the 10x10 L-5 lookout house. The story reports both.
The Oregon list says abandoned in the 1940s. The register and firelookout.com say gone by 1962. Both can be true (abandoned first, removed later), so the story reports both without choosing.

notes_for_editor: The brief's kind 'ground' is not stated in any source. The sources say L-5 cab or lookout house and give no tower height, so the record is left as is. The 1933 and 1934 build dates conflict and are not resolved. The 1932 item is a plan, not proof of construction. The Oregon list's 1933 panorama photo is not evidence of the build year. No source gives an access level, so access is left unset.
